properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Fan follows the complete uninterrupted delay.
Legal outputs satisfy the required range.
Auto unoccupied setback follows energy saving.
Comfort and Economy ignore energy saving.

If permit stays TRUE from any scan onward, the fan eventually runs, assuming continued calls and diverging physical time. Explicit non-Zeno environment premise: physical elapsed time crosses infinitely many 1ms boundaries.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.auto_save: mode=0 AND NOT occupancy AND ENERGY_SAVING_MODE
atomic_propositions.auto_standard: mode=0 AND NOT occupancy AND NOT ENERGY_SAVING_MODE
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB013(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
mode域0..3；permit=occupied & mode!=3，首次许可年龄0、失去立即清计时；fan=permit且年龄>=30s。adjust=mode3则4，否则有人则0，否则mode0取节能3/普通2、mode1取1、mode2取4。初始化adjust=0与首次调用计算分开。
atomic_propositions.TimeTick: Boolean: floor(t[k]/1ms)>floor(t[k-1]/1ms), with t[0]=0, TimeTick[0]=FALSE, t[k]=sum(dt_ms[1..k]). G(F(TimeTick)) states unbounded physical time progress; merely positive dt is insufficient.
atomic_propositions.SUPPLY_FAN_RUN: O[k].SUPPLY_FAN_RUN: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST: O[k].TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST: independently observed post-scan candidate value (INT); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.SUPPLY_FAN_RUN=false, O_init.TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST=0.
